_readme: Known i18n-coverage debt: hardcoded user-facing strings that predate the gate. Regenerate with `node scripts/i18n-coverage.mjs --write-baseline`. The gate fails on any violation NOT listed here and on any entry this file no longer matches — so this list can only shrink. Fix a string? Delete its line.
